Oversee the successful implementation and management of client healthcare programs, including corporate clinics and telehealth services. Supervise and mentor a team of specialists by guiding them in daily operations and fostering their professional development. Cross-Functional Learning : Opportunities to collaborate across different teams, expanding your skill set and broadening your understanding of the business. Health & Wellness Coverage : HMO benefits to ensure your peace of mind, paired with free medical consultations and unlimited essential medicines. jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Two designers. 20,000+ doctors. Millions of patients. That's our current ratio of team to impact. If you've worked on teams where your designs disappeared into endless review cycles, this is the opposite. SeriousMD and NowServing are healthcare products that people actually use daily. We need a Senior UI/UX Designer who can own product areas end-to-end, from research to shipped pixels. About Us Leapfroggr builds SeriousMD (the EMR platform Filipino doctors trust) and NowServing (connecting patients to providers nationwide). Our products handle real medical records, real appointments, real patient care. We're a small team by design. No layers, no approvals queue, no "let's circle back." You'll work directly with our Design Lead, engineers, and founders. What you design this week can ship next week. What You'll Actually Do Own UI/UX design for entire product areas across web, iOS, and Android. Take features from user research through wireframes through polished UI through shipped product. Build and extend our design system — we care about consistency at scale. Collaborate daily with engineering to make sure what ships matches what you designed. Run usability tests with real doctors and patients, then iterate based on what you learn. Present your work, defend your decisions, and stay open when you're wrong. What We Offer Remote-friendly (distributed across the Philippines) Health insurance Flexible hours Paid leave (sick, vacation, maternity/paternity, bereavement) Real ownership — your name is on the work, and the work matters How to Apply Send your portfolio showing your process, not just final screens. Tell us which of our products (SeriousMD or NowServing) you'd want to work on first, and why.

Assessing and coordinating support ticket escalation , prioritizing and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues based on business impact. Familiarity with virtualization and infrastructure technologies , such as VMware, servers, storage, firewall, and networking environments. Experience working in a structured technical support or service environment , managing tickets within defined service levels. Customer-oriented and adaptable mindset , with strong communication skills and willingness to support after-hours or on-call when required.

jobs.title: Audit Specialist
jobs.description: Responsible for conducting independent audits of warehouse operations, inventory transactions, and documentation to ensure inventory accuracy, compliance with company policies and procedures, and effectiveness of internal controls. The role involves physical inventory verification, transaction testing, reconciliation of inventory records, and monitoring of corrective and preventive actions to minimize discrepancies and operational risks. Key Responsibilities: Conduct regular physical inventory counts and verify actual stocks against Oracle/ERP system records. Audit receiving, storage, issuance, production returns, and dispatch transactions. Review and validate supporting documents, inventory records, and warehouse transactions. Investigate inventory discrepancies, including shortages, overages, unrecorded items, and recurring variances. Monitor the movement and accountability of raw materials, packaging materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and spare parts. Evaluate warehouse documentation, system records, authorization, and compliance with established procedures. Identify operational risks, control weaknesses, and potential inventory losses. Monitor corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Prepare clear and accurate audit reports with findings and recommendations. Coordinate with warehouse, production, and other departments regarding audit findings and follow-up activities.
